name: larena/core
description: Larena Core package: platform contracts, operation runtime, package registry and shared foundation.

scripts.validate:larena: php -r 'foreach (["module.yaml", "config/larena-core.php", "src/Contracts/OperationRuntime.php", "src/Contracts/OperationDescriptor.php", "src/Contracts/OperationContext.php", "src/Contracts/OperationResult.php", "src/Contracts/OperationDecision.php", "src/Enums/OperationExecutionMode.php", "src/Enums/OperationDecisionStatus.php"] as $file) { if (!is_file($file)) { fwrite(STDERR, "Missing {$file}\n"); exit(1); } } echo "Larena core contract skeleton is valid.\n";'
scripts.evidence:check:
php -r '$base = "docs/project-management/evidence/runtime-security/batch-1/core/"; foreach (["implementation-summary.md", "tests.md", "smoke.md", "file-map.json", "deviations.json", "graph-sync-proposal.json", "code-review-feedback.md"] as $file) { if (!is_file($base . $file)) { fwrite(STDERR, "Missing evidence {$base}{$file}
"); exit(1); } } $proposal = json_decode(file_get_contents($base . "graph-sync-proposal.json"), true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR); if (($proposal["canonical_update_allowed"] ?? null) !== false) { fwrite(STDERR, "graph-sync-proposal must keep canonical_update_allowed=false
"); exit(1); } echo "Evidence contract is valid for the implemented contract skeleton.
";'
